meta.name: update-workspace-skills
meta.description: Make sure to use this skill whenever the user mentions updating workspace skills, syncing skills to workspace, pulling global skills, ending a session to save skills, or when wrapping up work in this blueprint repository. This skill scans the skills present in the workspace `Skills` folder and updates them to match their latest versions in the global `.gemini` config skills folder.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 同步工作区技能到最新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常在多个工作区维护同一套技能
copy.tagline_en: Sync workspace skills to latest versions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain the same skills across multiple workspaces.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描工作区 Skills 文件夹,从全局 .gemini 配置的 skills 文件夹里复制最新版本覆盖进来,让工作区技能与全局保持一致。
howto.when: 当你说到“更新、同步、拉取工作区技能”等请求时触发;当你说要结束会话保存技能或在本仓库收尾时也会触发。

say.text: 把全局的最新技能同步到工作区
say.note: Claude 会扫描并覆盖更新 Skills 目录
会比对全局配置并复制最新版本

say.text: 结束会话前,保存一下技能

howto.what_en: This skill scans the workspace Skills folder and copies the latest versions from the global .gemini config skills folder, overwriting local files to keep them in sync.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to update, sync, or pull workspace skills, or mentions ending a session to save skills or wrapping up in this blueprint repo.

say_en.text: Sync the latest global skills to the workspace
say_en.note: Claude will scan and overwrite the Skills folder

say_en.text: Update the skills in the workspace
say_en.note: It compares with global config and copies latest versions

say_en.text: Save skills before ending the session
